## Iron Wight (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
CE Large undead  
**Init** +9; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +19  

**Defense**

 **AC** 24, touch 10, flat-footed 23 (+1 Dex, +24 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 180 (15d8+60)  
**Fort** +11, **Ref** +8, **Will** +10  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +2; **DR** 5/adamantine; **Immune** undead traits  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to electricity  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +18 (2d8+7 plus 2d6 energy [see special abilities])  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** cold fury, energized fists  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 12, Con—, **Int** 8, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +11; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 30  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Cleave, Critical Focus, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (slam), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Perception +19, Stealth +15, Survival +16  
**Languages** Common, +1 other (cannot speak)  
**SQ** rebuild  

**Special Abilities**

 **Cold Fury (Ex)** An iron wight gains a +2 profane bonus on attack and damage rolls against humanoids and robots.  

 **Energized Fists (Ex)** An iron wight incorporates parts from the robots it destroys, granting the wight integrated weapon systems that add 2d6 energy damage to its slam attacks. Choose one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, fire, plasma (half electricity, half fire), or sonic.  

 **Rebuild (Su)** An iron wight can reform its body from destroyed robots. As a standard action, an iron wight touching the remains of a destroyed robot heals 5d6 points of damage. An iron wight can only use this ability once on the same robot. When using this ability, the iron wight can change the type of energy damage inflicted by its energized fists as it incorporates new parts.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** cold to temperate plains  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or band (3-5)  
**Treasure** none
